The `package()` function is irrelevant for this gate, as `--noprepare` and `--nobuild` prevent its execution. No network calls or file operations outside of standard source fetching occur during the commands in scope.

Thus, running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` will safely download and verify the sources without executing any potentially malicious code.
</details>
